correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md specifies categorical (not Cartesian) K_a×K_b, a,b≥3, N=ab, unit edges and probability-normalized variance. Strict convexity/tight-edge connectivity forces integer potentials, diameter two gives levels 0,1,2, and row/column compatibility exhausts binary, full-line, singleton cross-star and 2×2 checkerboard types. Exact variance N(s+t)−(s−t)^2 and monotonicity of singleton-cross score yield the three stated envelopes; checkerboard ties only a=b=3. Independent enumeration of all three-level assignments on 3×3 and 3×4 verifies optimal numerators 36 and 56, not the infinite proof. The phase inequalities are algebraic and optimizer equality follows from strictly convex perturbation.
